- G = 1 sixteenth note = 1/16 = 0.25 quarter notes
- F = 1 sixteenth note = 0.25 quarter notes
- E = 1 sixteenth note = 0.25 quarter notes
- D = 1 sixteenth note = 0.25 quarter notes
